test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 08 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some cakes are samosas.

All samosas are buns.

**Conclusions:**

(I): Some cakes are buns.

(II): All buns are samosas.
solution:
Statements:

Some cakes are samosas.

All samosas are buns.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f222278e0debb14b7398eeb342adc06a5f76e3991a94fcb95cce7b06bc14b4f0.png] 

Conclusions:

(I): Some cakes are buns. - True (Because, Some cakes are samosas and All samosas are buns, which means the cakes which are samosas are buns.)

(II): All buns are samosas. - False (Because, All samosas are buns, which means some buns are samosas.)

Thus, Only conclusion (I) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
